Earl Spencer releases book with new claims about the British royals

Earl Spencer, the brother of Princess Diana, has published a new book that contains five claims about the British royal family described by media as bombshell or explosive. International news agencies reported the book's release and highlighted the number of claims but did not provide detailed content of the allegations. The coverage notes that the book has drawn significant attention in the press. No further specifics about the claims were disclosed in the reports. The story reflects growing media interest in the Spencer family's perspective on the monarchy.
